headline: RBI to hold ₹50,000 crore overnight VRR auction under LAF on November 30, 2026
summary_points: RBI will conduct an Overnight Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on Monday, November 30, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines remain as per Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

rows: As per Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022

who_is_affected: Banks and other LAF-eligible participants, and treasury teams tracking short-term system liquidity and money market rates.
action_required: Eligible participants wishing to bid should do so within the 09:30-10:00 AM window on November 30, 2026, following the 2022 operational guidelines.

social.linkedin:
RBI has announced an Overnight Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) on Monday, November 30, 2026.

Key details:
- Notified amount: ₹50,000 crore
- Tenor: 1 day
- Window: 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM
- Reversal date: Tuesday, December 1, 2026

The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions. Operational guidelines remain the same as those in RBI Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

For banks, treasury teams and finance professionals, such operations are a useful signal of how the central bank is managing short-term system liquidity and may influence overnight money market rates.

The release is Press Release 2026-2027/1583, issued on November 27, 2026.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release before acting.
